attacks.name: Infinity
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each basic Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those cards into your deck.

rules.label: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule
rules.text: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

text.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, it's not brushed diligently, it will become tangled...

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Nine Temptations
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 2 {Fire} Energy cards from your hand. If you do, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flare Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Flare Strike during your next turn.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Double Blaze
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {Fire} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 more damage, and this attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: TAG TEAM rule
rules.text: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Burning Road
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of {Fire} Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Hot Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the amount of {Fire} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Explosive Jet
attacks.text: Discard any amount of {Fire} Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Dedechange
